3. 1. 2. 8. 

18. Sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ: devalokūpapattiyā āvuso samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti?36 Nanu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ puṭṭhā aṭṭīyeyyātha, harāyeyyātha, jiguccheyyāthāti? Evambhante. Iti kira tumhe bhikkhave dibbena āyunā aṭṭīyatha, harāyatha, jigucchatha. Dibbena vaṇṇena - dibbena sukhena - dibbena yasena - dibbena ādhipateyyena, aṭṭīyatha, harāyatha, jigucchatha. Pageva kho pana bhikkhave tumhehi kāyaduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ, harāyitabbaṃ, jigucchitabbaṃ. Vacī duccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ, harāyitabbaṃ, jigucchitabbaṃ. Manoduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ, harāyitabbaṃ, jigucchitabbaṃ.
